title: Fail-Safe
description: The president (Henry Fonda) cannot stop a Strategic Air Command plane accidentally cued to bomb Moscow.

title: It Had to Be You
description: A marriage-shy sculptor (Ginger Rogers) meets the Indian boy of her childhood dreams, now a firefighter (Cornel Wilde).

title: The Trouble With Angels
description: A headstrong girl (Hayley Mills) and her best friend (June Harding) bedevil the mother superior (Rosalind Russell) of a convent school.

title: The End of the Affair
description: A civil servant's wife (Deborah Kerr) in wartime London vows to leave her injured lover (Van Johnson) if he recovers.

title: The Taming of the Shrew
description: Shakespeare's Petruchio weds Katharina on his own terms in Padua.

title: The Fuller Brush Man
description: A door-to-door salesman (Red Skelton) and his girlfriend (Janet Blair) solve a murder and wind up trapped in a war-surplus warehouse.

title: Three on a Couch
description: An artist tries to help his psychiatrist fiancée by posing as suitors for her lovesick patients.

title: 711 Ocean Drive
description: A telephone repairman (Edmond O'Brien) becomes the boss of a gambling syndicate he has ingeniously wired for profit.

title: Cat Ballou
description: When an outlaw (Lee Marvin) with a fake nose kills her father, a schoolmarm (Jane Fonda) hires his drunken twin to get revenge.

title: How to Save a Marriage and Ruin Your Life
description: A bachelor (Dean Martin) tries to save his buddy's (Eli Wallach) marriage by stealing his mistress, who is not who he thinks.

title: Hellcats of the Navy
description: A submarine commander (Ronald Reagan) enters the Sea of Japan with a frogman who had flirted with his girlfriend (Nancy Davis).

title: The Daring Young Man
description: After the military turns him down as being unfit, a man proves himself a hero by cracking a Nazi spy ring.

title: The Wrecking Crew
description: Secret agent Matt Helm (Dean Martin) and a blonde (Sharon Tate) track $1 billion in gold in the last of four Matt Helm movies.

title: Eight Iron Men
description: GIs sit in a bombed-out house with a comrade trapped outside; then one (Bonar Colleano) does something.

title: The Cockleshell Heroes
description: A British major (Jose Ferrer) and captain (Trevor Howard) lead marines in canoes on a mission to mine Nazi ships in Bordeaux.

title: Operation Mad Ball
description: An Army private (Jack Lemmon) and his buddies try to fraternize with nurses who are off-limits as officers.

title: The Mouse That Roared
description: The field marshal, prime minister and grand duchess (Peter Sellers) of Fenwick declare war on the United States.

title: There's Something About a Soldier
description: Five young men train to become military officers.

title: Dead Reckoning
description: A World War II hero (Humphrey Bogart) solves his buddy's murder, starting with a singer (Lizabeth Scott) and a nightclub owner (Morris Carnovsky).

title: The Wackiest Ship in the Army
description: A captain (Jack Lemmon) and his ensign (Ricky Nelson) take a sorry ship and crew on a World War II spy mission.

title: From Here to Eternity
description: While a Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor looms, an Army sergeant (Burt Lancaster), a former boxer (Montgomery Clift) and an officer's wife (Deborah Kerr) become entangled with others at an Army base on Oahu.

title: The Caine Mutiny
description: A World War II Naval officer is court-martialed for relieving paranoid Capt. Queeg of command during a typhoon.

title: Sahara
description: An Army sergeant (Humphrey Bogart), his tank crew (Bruce Bennett, Dan Duryea) and stragglers hold off a Nazi battalion at a waterhole.

title: First Men in the Moon
description: An old man (Edward Judd) recalls how he, his fiancée (Martha Hyer) and a professor (Lionel Jeffries) planted a Union Jack on the moon in 1899.

title: The Three Stooges in Orbit
description: Three men get mixed up with some Martian spies' invention.

title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad
description: Sinbad the sailor (Kerwin Mathews) needs the egg of a giant two-headed bird of prey to restore a shrunken princess (Kathryn Grant).

title: We Were Strangers
description: A Cuban (Jennifer Jones) lets a rebel (John Garfield) use her home as a base for digging a tunnel to blow up a dictatorship.

title: The Silencers
description: A secret agent (Dean Martin) stops a Chinese villain's atomic plot in the first of four Matt Helm movies.

title: The Bitter Tea of General Yen
description: A U.S. missionary (Barbara Stanwyck) is gradually seduced by a courtly warlord (Nils Asther) holding her in Shanghai.

title: The Ambushers
description: A secret agent (Dean Martin) saves a flying-saucer prototype and its pilot (Janice Rule) in the third of four Matt Helm movies.

title: The Chase
description: An escaped convict (Robert Redford) heads for his wife (Jane Fonda) and corrupt small-town Texans, who order a sheriff (Marlon Brando) to stop him.

title: Dr. Strangelove Or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb
description: President Muffley and his advisers man the Pentagon war room, as planes with bombs head toward Moscow.

title: Mr. Smith Goes to Washington
description: A country bumpkin faces ridicule and corruption when he takes his idealistic views to the nation's capital.

title: Berserk
description: Scotland Yard looks into spiking, buzz sawing and knifing at ringmaster Monica's traveling circus.

title: The Lone Wolf and His Lady
description: When a gem disappears from an exhibition, jewel-thief-turned-reporter Lone Wolf (Ron Randell) is accused.

title: Gidget Goes to Rome
description: Teenage Gidget (Cindy Carol) and boyfriend Moondoggie (James Darren) cause romantic confusion on vacation in Italy.

title: Scandal Sheet
description: When a New York tabloid editor (Broderick Crawford) accidentally kills his wife, his best reporters (Donna Reed, John Derek) figure it out.

title: To Sir, With Love
description: Unable to find employment in his field, a black engineer accepts a teaching position in a tough East End London school.

title: 5 Against the House
description: Friends (Guy Madison, Kim Novak, Brian Keith) join a college student's scheme to rob a Reno casino for kicks.

title: The Magic Carpet
description: An ousted prince harnesses the power of a mystical floor covering to drive a villainous caliph from the throne.

title: The Game That Kills
description: A man infiltrates a hockey team to investigate the death of his brother, the team's star left wing.

title: The Big Heat
description: When his investigation into a corrupt cop's suicide spawns a car bombing that takes the life of his wife, Police Sergeant Dave Bannion quits the force to pursue the case on his own.
